risk_classification.description: The categorization tier assigned to an applicant based on medical criteria which determines premium rates. Also written: Risk class, risk_class, Preferred Non-Tobacco. Captured on SURF-02.
risk_classification.title: risk_classification

underwriting_case_id.description: The unique reference identifier assigned to an underwriting application. Also written: case_id, Case ID, caseId, case UW-2026-00042, UW-2026-00051, UW-2025-00990. Captured on SURF-01.
underwriting_case_id.title: underwriting_case_id

underwriting_decision.description: The formal conclusion reached on a file, such as approving, postponing, or declining the application. Also written: Decline, Postpone, Refer, Decision Approve, decision option, Decision options. Captured on SURF-02.
underwriting_decision.title: underwriting_decision
